scripts.start: cd .. && UI_MODE=AWX BRAND='Red Hat' PRODUCT='Ansible Automation Platform' AWX_API_PREFIX='/api/controller/v2' AWX_WEBSOCKET_PREFIX='/api/controller/v2/websocket/' HUB_API_PREFIX='/api/galaxy' webpack serve --mode development --config ./platform/webpack.platform.cjs --port 4100 --open
scripts.build: cd .. && npm run clean && UI_MODE=AWX BRAND='Red Hat' PRODUCT='Ansible Automation Platform' AWX_API_PREFIX='/api/controller/v2' AWX_WEBSOCKET_PREFIX='/api/controller/v2/websocket/' HUB_API_PREFIX='/api/galaxy' webpack --mode production --config ./platform/webpack.platform.cjs --output-path build/platform
scripts.docker:build: cd .. && docker build --file platform/Dockerfile --target platform-ui --tag platform-ui --load .
scripts.docker:start: npm run docker:stop && docker run --name platform-ui -d -p 4100:443 -e PLATFORM_SERVER=$PLATFORM_SERVER platform-ui --wait && open https://localhost:4100
scripts.docker:build:run: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:run
